title: My 1099 Tax Helper
summary: 1099 forms guide, tax calculator & expense tracker 4 freelancers and contractors
description:
My 1099 Tax Helper is designed to help freelancers, independent contractors, and self-employed professionals manage 1099 income, track business expenses, and estimate taxes throughout the year.

🎯 WHO IS THIS APP FOR?

Freelancers and independent contractors
Gig workers (Uber, DoorDash, Upwork, Fiverr, etc.)
Self-employed professionals
Small business owners
Anyone receiving income reported on 1099 forms

📄 1099 FORMS GUIDE

Access structured guidance for obtaining common 1099 forms:

1099-NEC
1099-K
1099-MISC
1099-INT
1099-DIV
1099-G

Includes step-by-step instructions for retrieving tax documents from freelance platforms, rideshare and delivery services, payment processors, brokerage accounts, and financial institutions.

Use the built-in checklist to track collected forms from multiple income sources and stay organized during tax season.

🧮 1099 TAX CALCULATOR

Estimate federal tax liability using calculators based on current tax brackets and self-employment tax rates.

Simple Calculator
Estimate based on total 1099 income
Applies 2026 federal tax brackets
Calculates self-employment tax (15.3%)
Displays estimated total tax due
Advanced Calculator
Deduction tracking integration
Home office deduction estimator
Vehicle mileage deduction (2026 IRS standard rate)
Equipment and supply deductions
Retirement contribution estimates
Health insurance deductions
Category-based expense inputs
